thread:
maya: FYI we're launching a staged migration for v1 streaming payload + embedding alias remap. Need owners for: playbook, snippet updates, smoke tests, and SDK warning.
jon: Can you enumerate the exact changes so docs/snippets match? :mag:
maya: Short list: (1) v1 streaming will stop emitting partial token events for rwd-* models; users must switch to v2 streaming shape (json-chunks). (2) Embed aliases will map to new model ids (embed-legacy -> models.embed-v2).
elaine: I'll own JS + Python snippets. No canonical snippet yet — I'll draft tiny examples that show `stream_format: 'json-chunks'` and the new client.stream loop.
jon: JS sketch:
```
// JS v2 streaming
const s = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-stream-1', stream_format: 'json-chunks' });
for await (const chunk of s) { process.stdout.write(chunk.delta || ''); }
```
elaine: I'll add Python equivalent and note `max_latency` default changed to 40ms.
sean: QA: add a docs smoke that runs snippets against canary and asserts no 4xx and initial token under 500ms. Suggest script: `docs/smoke/run_stream_migration.sh` calling run_snippet for js/python.
maya: docs-bot, create a deprecation checklist template listing snippet updates, redirect rules, in-page banner, changelog entry, smoke test, and SDK runtime warning.
docs-bot: Done — checklist created at `deprecations/staged_migration_checklist.md` :white_check_mark:
jon: Proposed schedule: snippets by Wed EOD, PRs by Fri, smoke green Mon, public notice Wed. Tag me `@jon` for reviews.
sean: I'll reserve Dedicated for the smoke window and schedule canary test runs.
maya: Also include a short alias-replacement table in the playbook with recommended replacements and rough cost delta. I'll draft in the meta PR description.
elaine: SDKs should emit a runtime deprecation warning when v1 streaming params are used pointing to the playbook. Add changelog blurb for SDK releases.
jon: I'll triage PRs; use PR title pattern: `docs(migration): streaming v1 -> v2 playbook & snippets` so they're easy to find.
maya: I'll open a meta PR that links sub-PRs and contains the checklist. Ping here to split snippet ownership. :thumbsup:
